title: AAPS not syncing properly with AAPSClient
symptom: AAPS values are different than AAPSClient even though they seem to properly sync. Carbs and Temp Targets sent via NS treatment menu do not pass to AAPS. There is an inconsistency in IOB and Carbs between AAPS and NSClient, and carbs added via NSClient are not deleted when removed from NSClient Treatments.
evidence_quote: With websockets ON or OFF there is an inconsistency in IOB and Carbs between AAPS and NSClient.
